title: The order that did not arrive
premise: In the afternoon, Laura learns that one small item she expected from town is missing. Alicia has returned with the rest of the supplies and has to decide whether to offer a solution, an excuse, or neither.
pressures: Laura needs a workable substitute before the forge loses time
Alicia wants to be useful without promising what she cannot deliver
the missing item can become either a small inconvenience or a quiet test of trust
constraints: This is a town-day rehearsal, not canon for any event, relationship outcome, or future plot; use owner-approved dossier canon for personality.
Keep the disagreement small and actionable. No sudden lore, confession, or therapeutic resolution.
Any solution must be proposed through observable practical action.
allowedFacts: the exchange takes place near the forge in the afternoon
the rest of the delivery arrived
Laura has work waiting and Alicia can choose whether to help
